א.text: This letter is Alef. It is silent. It just holds a vowel, like ah. The picture word means lion.

בּ.text: This letter is Bet. It makes the sound at the start of bear. The picture word means house.

ג.text: This letter is Gimel. It makes the sound at the start of goat. The picture word means camel.

ד.text: This letter is Dalet. It makes the sound at the start of dog. The picture word means fish.

ה.text: This letter is Hey. It makes the sound at the start of hat. The picture word means mountain.

ו.text: This letter is Vav. It makes the sound at the start of van. The picture word means rose.

ז.text: This letter is Zayin. It makes the sound at the start of zebra. The picture word means zebra.

ח.text: This letter is Chet. It makes a scratchy throat sound, like clearing your throat. The picture word means cat.

ט.text: This letter is Tet. It makes the sound at the start of turtle. The picture word means peacock.

י.text: This letter is Yod. It makes the sound at the start of yellow. The picture word means moon.

כּ.text: This letter is Kaf. It makes the sound at the start of kite. The picture word means ball.

ל.text: This letter is Lamed. It makes the sound at the start of lion. The picture word means heart.

מ.text: This letter is Mem. It makes the sound at the start of moon. The picture word means car.

נ.text: This letter is Nun. It makes the sound at the start of nest. The picture word means snake.

ס.text: This letter is Samech. It makes the sound at the start of sun. The picture word means horse.

ע.text: This letter is Ayin. It is silent. It just holds a vowel. The picture word means tree.

פּ.text: This letter is Pey. It makes the sound at the start of pig. The picture word means elephant.

צ.text: This letter is Tsadi. It makes the sound at the end of cats. The picture word means turtle.

ק.text: This letter is Kof. It makes the sound at the start of kite. The picture word means monkey.

ר.text: This letter is Resh. It makes a soft r sound, from the back of the throat. The picture word means train.

שׁ.text: This letter is Shin. It makes the sound at the start of ship. The picture word means sun.

ת.text: This letter is Tav. It makes the sound at the start of turtle. The picture word means apple.
